title: 19# The Family Of Imran Part 1
arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; إِنَّ اللّهَ اصْطَفى آدَمَ وَ نُوحاً وَ آلَ إِبْراهیمَ وَ آلَ عِمْرانَ عَلَى الْعالَمینَ۝

ذُرِّيَّةًۢ بَعْضُهَا مِنۢ بَعْضٍۢ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ۝

آلَ إِبْراهیمَ آلَ عِمْرانَ إِنَّ اللّهَ اصْطَفى آدَمَ وَ نُوحاً ذُرِّيَّةًۢ بَعْضُهَا مِنۢ بَعْضٍۢ ۗ إِنَّهُۥ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَٰلِحٍۢ ۖ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says;

إِذْ قَالَتِ امْرَأَتُ عِمْرَانَ رَبِّ إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِي بَطْنِي نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِي بَطْنِي نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُهُمْ وَإِيَّاكُمْ ۚ

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; نَحْنُ نَرْزُقُكُمْ وَإِيَّاهُمْ۝

قُوا أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَارًا وَقُودُهَا النَّاسُ وَالْحِجَارَةُ مُحَرَّرًا نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِي بَطْنِي مُحَرَّرًا ابتعثنا الله لنخرج العبادمن عبادة العباد إلى عبادة رب العبادمن عبادة العباد إلى عبادة رب العبادومن ضيق الدنيا إلى سَعَتِ الدُّنيَا وَلآخِرَة

ومن جور الأديان الی سعت الإسلام مخلصاً بالله عزّوجل Pure for Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ۝

فَلَمَّا وَضَعَتْهَا قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي وَضَعْتُهَا أُنثَىٰ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتْ وَلَيْسَ الذَّكَرُ كَالْأُنثَىٰ ۖ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says;

وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتْ وَلَيْسَ الذَّكَرُ كَالْأُنثَىٰ ۖ وَلَيْسَ الذَّكَرُ كَالْأُنثَىٰ ۖ اَللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتْ اَللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتْ

اَللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتْ وَلَيْسَ الذَّكَرُ كَالْأُنثَىٰ ۖ خيرُ نساءِ العالمينَ أربعٌ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتْ وَلَيْسَ الذَّكَرُ كَالْأُنثَىٰ ۖ وَإِنِّي سَمَّيْتُهَا مَرْيَمَ

یستحل صالحٓا الشَّيْطَانَ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ فَاتَّخِذُوهُ عَدُوًّا ۚ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ خَذُولًا۝

وَإِنِّي أُعِيذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ۝

يتكلم في المهد Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍ وَأَنبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًا صَدَقُوا مَا عَاهَدُوا اللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ ۖ

صَدَقُوا مَا عَاهَدُوا اللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ ۖ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَأُمُّهُۥ صِدِّيقَةٌ ۖ So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ

إِنَّ اللّهَ اصْطَفى آدَمَ وَ نُوحاً وَ آلَ إِبْراهیمَ وَ آلَ عِمْرانَ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ ۚ

وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يُلْقُونَ أَقْلَامَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ۝

لَّقَدْ رَضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحْتَ ٱلشَّجَرَة وَاشْتَعَلَ الرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُ ۖ

هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُ ۖ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً ةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَنَادَتْهُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُوَ قَآئِمٌ يُصَلِّى فِى ٱلْمِحْرَابِ وَهُوَ قَآئِمٌ يُصَلِّى فِى ٱلْمِحْرَابِ

أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكَ بِيَحْيَىٰ مُصَدِّقًۢا بِكَلِمَةٍۢ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَسَيِّدًا وَحَصُورًا وَنَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ۝

مُصَدِّقًۢا بِكَلِمَةٍۢ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ كُن فَيَكُونُ۝

وَسَيِّدًا وَحَصُورًا وَنَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ۝

وَنَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ۝

قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌ ۖ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ۝

قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةً ۚ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; قَالَ آيَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ إِلَّا رَمْزًا ۗ إِلَّا رَمْزًا ۗ

وَاذْكُر رَّبَّكَ كَثِيرًا وَسَبِّحْ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِبْكَارِ۝

وَاذْكُر رَّبَّكَ كَثِيرًا وَسَبِّحْ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِبْكَارِ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُ زَكَرِيَّا۝

إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُ نِدَاءً خَفِيًّا۝

قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي وَهَنَ الْعَظْمُ مِنِّي وَاشْتَعَلَ الرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُن بِدُعَائِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا۝

وَإِنِّي خِفْتُ الْمَوَالِيَ مِن وَرَائِي وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَتِي عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ فَهَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّا۝

وَإِنِّي خِفْتُ الْمَوَالِيَ مِن وَرَائِي فَهَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّا۝

يَرِثُنِي وَيَرِثُ مِنْ آلِ يَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَاجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا۝

إنَّا مَعَاشِرَالْأَنْبِيَاءِ لَا نُورَثُ مَا تَرَكْنَاهُ صَدَقَة اسْمُهُ يَحْيَىٰ لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيًّا۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says here; قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٌ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْئًا۝

الأمر بالمعروف والنهي عن المنكر Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ أَن سَبِّحُواْ بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا۝

أمر بالمعروف والنهي عن المنكر يَا يَحْيَىٰ خُذِ الْكِتَابَ بِقُوَّةٍ ۖ خُذِ الْكِتَابَ بِقُوَّةٍ ۖ So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَآتَيْنَاهُ الْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّا۝

الْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّا ما لله بخلقنا وَحَنَانًا مِّن لَّدُنَّا بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ۝

وَزَكَوٰةً ۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيًّا۝

وَبَرًّا بِوَالِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّا۝

ان سكرات الموت وَجَاءَتْ سَكْرَةُ الْمَوْتِ بِالْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَسَلَامٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّا۝

صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ
english:
Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; Allah chose Adam(آدَم), Nuh(نوح), the family of Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم), and the family of Imran(عمران) above Al-Alameen(الْعالَمینَ).

Offspring one of the other and Allah is All Hearer, All Knower.

Adam(آدَم) was chosen; Istafa(اصْطَفى); Istafa(اصْطَفى) means; chose.

So Adam(آدَم) is chosen and Nuh(نوح).

And then, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; And; With Adam(آدَم) and Nuh(نوح); Allahسُبحانه وتعالى mentioned their names alone; Adam(آدَم) and Nuh(نوح).

Allah has chosen Adam(آدَم) and Nuh(نوح).

But with Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) and Imran(عمران), Allah said; Aal-Ibrahim(آل-اِبْراهِيْم) and Aal-Imran(آل-عمران).

And Aal(آل) means; the family.

So, Adam(آدَم) was chosen; Nuh(نوح) was chosen, and then, Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) and his family were chosen, and Imran(عمران) and his family were chosen.

They are offspring of one another because; Aal-Imran(ال-عمران) are from the descendants of Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم), and Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) is from the descendants of Nuh(نوح), and Nuh(نوح) is from the descendants of Adam(آدَم).

These are the chosen ones of the world.

But then the chosen out of all humanity and all of the creation is; Muhammadﷺ.

Aal-Ibrahim(آل-اِبْراهِيْم) and Aal-Imran(آل-عمران); and Aal-Ibrahim(آل-اِبْراهِيْم) includes the ones who believe in the message of truth.

Because, we know that part of the family of Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) are Al-Yahood(اليهود).

But they are not included in this; because as soon as there is Kuffr(كفر), then the ties of relationship are cut.

So they are not part of the Aal-Ibrahim(آل-اِبْراهِيْم) anymore.

And that's why, Ahl al-Bayt(اهل البيت) does not include within them; Abu Lahab(ابو لهب); Abu Lahab(ابو لهب) is not considered from Ahl al-Bayt(اهل البيت);

Ahl al-Bayt(اهل البيت) of Rasool Allah ﷺ are the ones who believed in Muhammadﷺ from his family.

But the ones who did not believe, they're not included in Ahl al-Bayt(اهل البيت).

And the same thing with Nuh(نوح) when he said; This is my son, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى told him; He's not from your family, he is not part of your relatives to start with.

Because, he's on unrighteous deeds.

Aal-Imran(آل-عمران) are from the descendants of Sayidina Ibrahimعليه السلام.

And Aal-Imran(آل-عمران) are the family of Sayidina Eesaعليه السلام, and that's the family of Zakariyya عليه السلام, and the family of Yahya عليه السلام.

They are from the family the household of Aal-Imran(آل-عمران).

This righteous woman; the wife of Imran(عمران); Imran(عمران) is the name of the father.

He's the head of this household; his name is Imran(عمران).

His wife said; Oh Allah! I vowed to you; what is in my womb.

An-Nazr(نَذَرْ) is a promise and a vow that you give.

Imra'tu Imran(امرأة عمران); she gave a vow; a promise that, what is in a womb(she was pregnant) is for Allah.

Specifically, that means that, this child will serve in the Masjid(مسجد).

Which Masjid(مسجد)?

Al-Masjid al-Aqsa(المسجد الاقصى).

In that time they used to have men, who are devoted to Khidmat ul Masjid(خدمت المسجد).

They were devoted to the serving of the Masjid(مسجد).

The ones, who would fill this job were men.

They didn't allow a women to take this job; it was for men.

And they would live their entire life in the Masjid(مسجد) and serve in the Masjid(مسجد).

So Imra'tu Imran(امرأة عمران) said; Oh Allah! I'm vowing my child to you; to the Khidmah(خدمة) of Al-Masjid(المسجد).

And I think these Ayaat(آيات); that deals with the parents and children; we need to reflect on them.

We're not going to spend a lot of time doing this reflection now.

But take this as a pointer and a tip, when you're reading through the Ayaat(آيات) of Qur'an, when you see the relations between the parents and the children within the righteous families; try to think about it and reflect and contemplate.

Over here, Imra'tu Imran(امرأة عمران) is vowing her child to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى to serve in the Masjid(مسجد).

Imra'tu Imran(امرأة عمران); she was not thinking in terms of Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) at all.

She wanted her child to go to the service in the Masjid al-Aqsa(مسجد الاقصى).

Not for a certain time, and then come back to her and generate money; For the whole life.

She wants her son because the service is for men.

She wanted her son to go in the Masjid(مسجد) and serve in the Masjid(مسجد).

I think; we should learn from the ones, whom Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has chosen.

These are the ones whom Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has given Istafa(اصْطَفى).

And they should be the role models for us.

We need to take care of the religious matters of our children more than the Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) matters.

Because the one, who is giving them Rizq(رزق) is Allah not us.

We are not the ones, who are giving them Rizq(رزق).

And that's why, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; In two Ayaat(آيات).

One Ayah(آية), Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; We give you Rizq(رزق), and We give them Rizq(رزق).

And in another Ayah(آية), Allah says; We give them Rizq(رزق), and We give you Rizq(رزق).

One time; they will mentioned before us, and one time we were mentioned before them.

In all; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is the One, Who is giving Rizq(رزق).

Allah is the One, Who created every human being, and Allahسُبحانه وتعالى created with the human being its Rizq(رزق).

We are not the ones, who are providing for them.

Therefore, we need to pay attention to the religious matters of our children.

And that's why, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; Save yourselves and your families from hell fire. Save yourselves and your families from Hellfire.

Now, He didn't say; save themselves from hunger even though; we should.

So Imra'tu Imran(امرأة عمران) was devoting her child to the serving of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى in Al-Masjid al-Aqsa(المسجد الاقصى).

And then, she said; Free from all worldly work.

If we just take the word Muharrar(مُحَرَّر), it means; free; freedom.

This word freedom has been used by every revolutionary group in the world.

Everyone is seeking freedom.

Every movement of revolution comes under the banner of freedom.

Freedom is a quality that every human being is striving to get.

And over here, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is giving us the definition of this Istalah(اصطلاح); the definition of this word.

What is freedom?

Because we all want freedom.

So what's the meaning of this word?

What's the definition of freedom?

And we get the definition from the mouth of the wife of Imran(عمران).

When she said that, her child is going to be the servant of Allah, in the Masjid(مسجد) of Allah.

When her son is going into servitude; Abudiyyah(عبوديه); to serve Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

She said; that is Tehreer(تحرير); that is the freedom for my child.

Because if you are not a slave of Allah; you're going to be a slave of something else.

If you're not a servant of Allah; you're going to be serve something else.

If you don't serve Allah; you're going to serve money, you're going to serve your desires, you might serve a king, or a human being.

The only way that you could be free and is when; you devote yourself in sincerity and you serve Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

That's the only way you could be free.

And that's why, Rabie Bin Aamir(ربيع بن عامر); when he went to meet with the Persian commander, and the Persian commander said; What did you come here for?

Because the Persian commander knows the Arab people before Islam.

The Arab people before Islam were dis-united tribes, hungry, poor; and they were so poor; they would eat the skin of dead animals.

When do we make the Dhikr(ذكر) of As-Sabah(الصباح)?

We make it after Fajr(فجر).

And when do we make the Dhikr(ذكر) of nighttime?

We do it after Asr(عصر).

And this is in this Ayah(آية).

Remember the name of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى in the morning and afternoon.

These were the Ayaat(آيات) from Surat(سورت) Al-Imran(آلعمران).

Let's read the Ayaat(آيات) which are talking about the same story from Surat(سورت) Maryam(مريم).

Allahسُبحانه وتعال says about Sayidina Zakariyya(سيدنا زَكَرِيا).

He said; My Lord! Indeed my bones have grown feeble.

He's very old.

And gray hair has spread on my head, and I have never been unblessed in my invocation to you.

He said; Oh Allah! You always respond to my Dua(دُعَا).

Zakariyya(زَكَرِيا) said; I verily fear my relatives after me.

Zakariyya عليه السلام being the Nabi(نَبِي); he was the one responsible for the religious affairs of Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).

Sayidina Zakariyya(سيدنا زَكَرِيا), when he became old; he was worried that there's no one qualified to take over after him.

Therefore, he wanted to have a child that would be strong and capable to lead Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل), and to teach them, and to bring them back to the straight path.

So he said; So give me from Yourself a heir.

Who shall inherit me and inherit the property of Yaqoob(يعقوب).

What inheritance are we talking about here?

What is the inheritance?

It is Prophet-hood.

It is not wealth.

Because Rasool Allah ﷺ says; We; the prophets; we do not leave behind an inheritance.

Whatever we leave behind is As-Sadaqah(الصّدقه); charity.

So, here Zakariyya(زَكَرِيا) wants to inherit to his son, Prophet-hood.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said; Oh Zakariyya(زَكَرِيا)! Verily, We give you the glad tidings of a son.

Here, we have another attribute of Yahya(يحيى).

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; We have given that name to none before him.

His name is Yahya(يحيى); the first person to be named Yahya(يحيى) in the whole history of the world, was Sayidina Yahyaعليه السلام.

This was a new name that was chosen for Sayidina Yahyaعليه السلام before he was delivered.

And this name was given to him by Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

The name; Yahya(يحيى) was not chosen by the Zakariyya(زَكَرِيا) or his wife.

The name Yahya(يحيى) was chosen by Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

Allah is the one who named him Yahya(يحيى).

And he asked the same question; how can this happen when I'm old and my wife is barren?

He said; Your Lord says; it is easy for me.

Certainly, I have created you before, when you have been nothing.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said; it's easy for me to create Yahya(يحيى) this way.

You were nothing before.

Just like, you were nothing; it's easy to create Yahya عليه السلام.

Now, the following Ayaat(آيات), or actually, this Ayah(آية) is also similar to the Ayah(آية) of Al-Imran(آلعمران) in terms of his inability to speak.

But what is different here; is that even though, he was unable to speak; he never stopped calling the people to making; Zakariyya(زَكَرِيا); even though, he was unable to speak for those three days; he did not discontinue in joining good and forbidding evil.

Then, he came out to his people from his place of worship, and he told them by signs, to glorify Allah in the morning and in the afternoons.

So even though, he was unable to speak; he still was giving the people orders using signs, that they should make the Dhikr(ذكر) to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

And this is an indication to us that we are in our full physical abilities, and we are withholding; We are withholding Da'wah(دعوة); even though, we are fully capable of doing it.

Sayidina Zakariyyahعليه السلام was not capable of speaking for three days, that did not deter him from fulfilling his duties of Da'wah(دعوة) to his people.

And this shows you the amazing devotion, that the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى had.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى in the next three Ayaat(آيات); actually four; talks about Sayidina Yahya(سيدنا يحيى).

Allah says; Allah says; Oh Yahya(يحيى)! Hold fast the scripture.

Kitab(كتاب) is a scripture; At-Torah(التّوراة).

What does this word mean; Quwwah(قُوَّة)?

Here it says; hold fast.

But what is the meaning of the word Quwwah(قُوَّة)?

Quwwah(قُوَّة) is power and strength.

That's the meaning of Quwwah(قُوَّة).

What this means is that; you hold fast to all of the commands of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, and you don't let go of them.

So you never give up and you never buckle down.

You're always holding fast, holding strong to the commands of Allah.

Yahya عليه السلام; because we need to understand the position of Yahya(يحيى).

Yahya عليه السلام is young and he is going to be the Nabi(نَبِي) of Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).

Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) who, went corrupt, and went astray.

And this young man will be responsible for this ummah(امة); for this nation.

Therefore; he must have that strength and confidence and power.

Otherwise, he would not be able to function.

And he would be swept away by the ocean of corruption that was existing in the time.

Sayidina Yahyaعليه السلام never gave up this order of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, and the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; they never give up the orders of Allah; they fulfill them.

So, Sayidina Yahya(سيدنا يحيى) received this order from Allah.

And that is that you should hold fast and strong to the religion.

So Sayidina Yahyaعليه السلام held strong to the religion of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, and he ended up giving his life for the religion of Allah, and he died as As-Shaheed(الشَّهِيد).

Because, of holding strong to the religion; Sayidina Yahyaعليه السلام was assassinated.

That was the end of the life of Sayidina Yahya(سيدنا يحيى).

It was a life of struggle; a life of striving; a difficult life.

But Sayidina Yahya(سيدنا يحيى) was able to hold throughout that period with patience, until he faced Allahسُبحانه وتعالى as As-Shaheed(الشَّهِيد).

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; now even though; Allah Has given him this very strong responsibility, or very heavy responsibility, but Allahسُبحانه وتعالى gave him the tools and the ability to fulfill it.

We Have given him the judgment, and the understanding, and the wisdom; when he was young.

Because Allahسُبحانه وتعالى does not overburden a person.

Allah will not ask you to do something, you're un capable of doing.

Since, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has put a very heavy responsibility on Sayidina Yahya(سيدنا يحيى).

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى also equipped Sayidina Yahya(سيدنا يحيى) with the tools to carry on with that responsibility and that is; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى Has given him this understanding very, very early on.

And the Mufassireen(مفسرين) mentions some things, for example; they say that Yahya(يحيى) was a kid, was a child and the children came to him and said;

Let's go and play; very young child.

So Sayidina Yahyaعليه السلام said; We were not created to play.

So he was serious from his childhood.

He was sympathetic.

Don't understand that strength means; I mean; because sometimes, we misinterpret words.

Don't think that strength means; being extreme, or being rude, or being rough.

That's not the meaning of the word strong.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was the strongest.

But he was still the most merciful.

With the believers; merciful and compassionate.

Because sometimes, we think that strong means that, you have a very rough heart, insensitive, have no sympathy, no mercy that's not what is meant by strength.

What is meant by strength is; that you're holding to the commands of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى completely.

All of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) of Allah was sympathetic, but Sayidina Yahya(سيدنا يحيى); that was a strong attribute of him.

Some of the Mufassireen(مفسرين) say; it means; sympathetic towards his parents.

Some of them say; its general; he was sympathetic towards all people.

And he was pure.

And he was righteous.

And dutiful towards his parents, and he was neither arrogant nor disobedient.

Security and peace is important for us in our life.

The most difficult phases are the transition phases that we go through.

And we go through three transition phases.

When we're in the wombs of our mothers; we spend nine months in the comfort and warmth of the mother's body.

It's very cozy and small room warm.

So the child is comfortable; you never hear the child crying in the womb of the mother.

When the child is delivered; the child is going through a completely different stage of their life.

They're going from the nine months stage in the womb to a completely different world.

So the warmth and small, coziness of the womb of the mother disappears.

Suddenly, you come in a completely open space.

So the first reaction of the child is what?

Cry.

It's a difficult transition.

That phase of transition is difficult.

Because you're going to an entirely different stage.

You're going to the unexpected and the unknown.

And then; we live in this Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) and we get used to it.

Unfortunately, some of us get too much attached to it.

We spent here some time and then it's time for us to move to the next stage.

So we go through another transition phase, and that is; death.

The last moments, you find that the person is going through consciousness and unconsciousness, and that alternates.

That person is actually going back and forth, in Duniyah(دُنِيَّا); in and out.

And that transition phase, is slowly taking the person out of the realm of this world.

Slowly, slowly, he's leaving this Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) and the person is aware that he's leaving.

And that's much much more difficult than the transition phase that we talked about before.

Because you spent a long time in this Duniyah(دُنِيَّا), and now you're leaving to a completely unknown world and that is, Al-Barzakh(البرزخ); the grave.

And those are very difficult moments.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ has spoken them in the Ahadith(احاديث) and the Ayaat(آيات) of Qur'an; Now the moments of death have approached you; that is what you're trying to run away from.

You can't run away from it now; you're facing it.

And here you are; you're going to cross the line.

And as soon as you cross it; there's no way back.

That's another very critical and difficult phase of the human being.

And then you are living in your graves; you have awareness.

Even though, your body can't move, but you're still conscious.

And now it's time for you to go through the third transition phase.

And that is; the resurrection and this is the worse.

Because now; you suddenly have a grave that has popped open; you crawl out of that grave.

And you come and see an entirely different world.

The sky above your head is cracking.

The stars are falling down.

The moon knocked out of his orbit.

The sun right over your head.

Mountains are exploding and turning into dirt.

The oceans are catching fire and burning.

There's an earthquake and it's cracking open.

And you see people running around you as if they're drunk.

So that is the worst; that is the worst of the three transition stages.

And this is when we need security and peace most.

Because these are the most difficult moments.

When you read the description of what happens in Al-Ba'th(اَلْبَعَثْ); it is something unbelievable.

If we are able to comprehend it.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has give Sayidina Yahya(سيدنا يحيى) very, very interesting blessing.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; And peace be on him; the day he was born; and the day he dies; and the day he will be raised up again.

See in these three difficult moments; these critical moments; when you are in great need, in dire need of peace; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has given that peace to Sayidina Yahya(سيدنا يحيى).

Allah has given him peace when he was born; the day he was born.

And Allah gave him peace; the day he died.

And Allah Will give him peace the day he will be resurrected again.

We ask Allahسُبحانه وتعالى to give us peace.
